question: Does activity-facet fragmentation recur across every complete exposure-bracket pattern observed in the Flight Day 6 raw crew-camera labels, and does any repeated within-action signature argue against a simple activity-boundary explanation?
terminal_objective: Test whether the two Forward Look fractures are isolated curiosities or instances of a repeated mismatch between archive search units and camera-action units.
method: Complete-denominator, label-only camera-action integrity audit across four observed Nikon bracket sequences
authority: Read-only replay of already preserved public metadata and private local repository updates only. No image pixels, publication, outreach, scientific acceptance, or correction of NASA source labels.

baseline.reason_for_expansion: The Flight Day 6 labels contain additional complete three- and five-frame exposure-bracket patterns that provide a larger camera-native action denominator.

complete_bracket_contract.selection: Within each instrument serial, sort by shutter_count. Beginning only at bracket value 0, admit the longest matching allowed sequence whose settings, consecutive counters, and time span satisfy every rule; advance by the admitted frame count. Partial sequences are excluded.

scored_outcomes.activity_facet_fracture: A complete camera-native exposure bracket contains more than one non-empty activity_id.
scored_outcomes.repeated_position_signature: At least three consecutive complete actions repeat the same activity and target assignment by exposure position.
scored_outcomes.interpretation: A fracture proves that an activity-only facet can divide one physical camera action. A repeated position signature weakens a pure temporal-boundary explanation but does not identify the correct activity, authoring mechanism, image content, or scientific meaning.

claim_ceiling: Stage 10C may establish recurrence and repeated within-action structure for complete Flight Day 6 raw crew-camera exposure brackets. It cannot identify which label is correct, call every fracture an error, infer image content or scientific meaning, assign one authoring cause, estimate rates for non-bracket products or other flight days, or conclude that activity facets lack coarse retrieval value.

next_step_logic.if_no_recurrence: Retire the systematic camera-action mismatch thesis and keep only the two verified Forward Look exceptions.
next_step_logic.if_recurrence_without_structure: Treat fractures as sparse action-boundary exceptions and test another flight day before making any broader retrieval recommendation.
next_step_logic.if_repeated_position_structure: Investigate documented metadata-generation rules and representation multiplicity, then test all raw crew-camera days before broadening scope.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised PDS label set, a documented per-frame activity-override procedure, or complete all-flight-day raw metadata may change the interpretation.
